one_line: Open on an object that turns into something else, show the build, end on the same smash.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a girl about 10 to 12 lifts a decorated cake to her mouth, then holds it to the lens, eyes wide. English text "Cake or fake" from 0:02 (transcript: "קייקו פייק"). At 0:04 she slaps it: slime inside.
q1_hook.why: A face and a visual stunt from the first second (H4, E1, H1): she lifts the cake to bite, then slaps it into slime at 0:04, so the cake-or-fake question is answered fast (H5). The title matches what is heard (H6, T3), though it appears at 0:02 and is English.

beats.what: She lifts the cake to her mouth, then holds it to the lens; "Cake or fake"
beats.why: A trend question with an exaggerated face

beats.what: She slaps the cake; it turns into slime; she stretches it to the lens
beats.why: The answer comes fast and it is visual

beats.what: Behind a table of kit packets she throws one at the lens; "בואו איתי להכין עוגה מסליים"
beats.why: Names what the Reel will show

beats.what: Top-down: the lid lifts on compartments, a QR code and a piping bag
beats.why: Shows what is in the box

beats.what: She stretches yellow slime, laughing, and moulds a base on the pink stand
beats.why: The first build step with a reaction

beats.what: She holds up the teal cake: "וואו איזה זילוף מקצועי אני עושה"; close-up piping
beats.why: A humorous line and a close shot

beats.what: She opens a candy packet: "והחלק הכייפי הסוכריות"; hands place candy balls
She shows the finished cake, then squishes it into slime, laughing
beats.why: The squish repeats the opening smash

beats.what: Close-ups of the box and packets with "Slimy" and "Slimy Sugar Crush"

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption's first line is a question aimed at girls, "יש בנות שלא אוהבות סליים ?", and a follow ask. The video itself asks nothing.
q2_flow.why: The cake-or-fake gap closes by 0:04 (H5), then the build is told in short steps with her reactions, and the squish at 0:35 repeats the opening smash (K2, R4). The 0:06 to 0:14 setup is slower (R3), and the brand arrives only at 0:37.

q3_cta.what: No ask in the video: the last 4 s show the box and packets with the product name. Caption: "לעוד משחקים , פעילויות וכל מה שחם בעולם הילדים עקבו" with the account's handle, then a cut-off "בשיתו" and @palphot.
q3_cta.why: A follow ask with a vague reason, more content, sits in the caption only (C6, C2), and the video ends on the product name with no price, link or where to buy (C6). The brand text is on screen about 3 of 41 s, a light touch (C7, H3).

q4_shown.what: A decorated cake at 0:00 that becomes slime at 0:04; kit packets at 0:06; the open box and a QR code at 0:12; kneading, moulding, piping, sprinkles, candy balls; the finished cake at 0:32; the squish at 0:35; box and packets at 0:37. No price.
q4_shown.why: The result, a cake that turns to slime, comes first, then the whole make is shown in use with a lively face and laughter (S1, K8, F8). The brand appears on packs all along, but as text only at 0:37 (H3). A child's face on camera is what S5 warns about.

q5_edit.what: About 22 shots in 40 s (first pass), about 1.8 s each, quick cuts in the first 20 s, then static mediums and top-down close-ups for piping and candies. No speed ramps seen. Hebrew subtitles from 0:06. Ends on packets with brand text.
q5_edit.why: A lunge to the lens and a fast first 20 s give early motion (E1, E2). Short subtitles in the middle band follow her speech (E4, T2, T4). The last 4 s of packets add no new information (E8, R1).

q6_topic.what: A "cake or fake" trend hook that turns a cake into slime, then a step-by-step slime kit demo; it serves girls and parents looking for a fun screen-free activity.
q6_topic.why: A surprise and laughter peak (K1), a screen-free activity (K6), and a trend reused with the kit's own scene and voice, so it adds its own value (E7). The cake-or-fake gag is not a parenting moment, so it is less relatable than K3 asks for (K3).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld phone at eye level in a bright living room with shelves, a TV and a marble table; lunges to the lens in the hook; static mediums for the steps; a top-down shot of the open box; close-ups of hands piping and placing candies.
q7_filmed.why: She speaks and reacts to the lens (F6), and close-ups of piping and candies fill the frame (F4). Daylight and a real home look native (F7), though the styled room and kids-channel look are more polished than a quick parent clip (H8). The last shots blur (F7).

q8_text.on_screen: English "Cake or fake" in glowing white and pink, centre, 0:02 to 0:03. White Hebrew subtitles, 2 lines, centred about 55% down, from 0:06: "בואו איתי להכין עוגה מסליים", "פעילות כיפית ללא מסכים וממש מספקת", "וואו איזה זילוף מקצועי אני עושה", "והחלק הכייפי הסוכריות". 0:37 "Slimy Sugar Crush".
q8_text.caption: "יש בנות שלא אוהבות סליים ?". About 54 words: the steps like a real cake, "Slimy sugar Crush", a follow ask, a cut-off "בשיתו" and @palphot. No hashtags.
q8_text.why: The mid-frame subtitles are short and safe (T2, T4), and the hook title states the topic early (T3). The caption's first line is a hook but has no hashtags (T7). The partnership word is cut off, so disclosure is not clear (T8, S7).

weak_points: The brand shows as text only at 0:37; an English title; the spoken part hard to follow in the transcript; a cut-off partnership word in the caption; a child's face on camera; no price, link or ask in the video.
lumebook_takeaway: Start with a plain-looking closed book or box that opens to the child's name within 3 s, hands only, then flip the pages.
not_verified: What she says (the transcript is garbled; only subtitles from 0:06 are reliable, and the 0:00 words are a guess); whether she owns the account; the role of reutmar as coauthor; music or a trending sound; the full partnership word. Correction to src/coded: the English title first appears at 0:02, not in the first frame. Cut count from the first pass.
